title: Define the artefact types SGI governs
requirements:
- Enumerate governed artefact types (terminologies, value sets, logical models, IGs/profiles, mappings, identifier systems, indicators, computable guidelines, benefit rules)
- Make validation, dependency/impact analysis, localisation and deprecation visible in or mapped to the five categories
- Distinguish entity registries (client, facility, workforce, product) from terminology and information-model governance
- Include implementation guides, profiles, mappings, data elements, measures, computable guidelines and transformation specifications in SGI scope
- Consider an SGI capability for professional domains to define the minimum meaning that must persist across an end-to-end care process
- Indicate which capabilities apply universally and which are artefact-specific
- Separate monitoring of governance process, artefact quality, adoption and runtime use
- Reserve 'metadata registry' for registries whose content is metadata, or define the broader category
